skill.name: ai-social-media-content
skill.description: Generate social media videos, images, thumbnails, captions, and hashtags for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X using inference.sh workflows.
skill.summary: Create platform-ready social media assets and copy with inference.sh CLI examples.
skill.author: inference-sh-9

security_audit.summary: The skill is a workflow guide for generating social media content with the inference.sh CLI, and most shell findings are expected examples or markdown fence matches. The quick start still includes a critical curl-to-sh installer pattern, so publication should require remediation before automatic installation.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell on SKILL.md line 16.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-sh with manual download steps, checksum verification, and a command that runs only after local inspection.

remediation.issue: Examples run infsh commands that send prompts, media URLs, and generated assets to hosted services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear data-sharing notice and require user confirmation before running networked generation commands.

remediation.issue: Related skill installation commands use npx against a community repository without a pinned reference.
remediation.suggestion: Pin related skill install commands to a trusted version or move them to non-executable reference text.

content.value_statement: Social teams need platform-specific assets and copy without rebuilding each format from scratch. This skill provides inference.sh workflows for videos, images, captions, hashtags, and thumbnails.
actual_capabilities: Provides ready-made inference.sh commands for short-form video generation.
Includes image workflows for carousels, thumbnails, and visual posts.
Shows caption, hook, and hashtag prompts for social media posts.
Covers platform format targets for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
Demonstrates batch creation and multi-platform repurposing workflows.
References voiceover and AI avatar workflows for talking-head content.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Generated content quality depends on the selected hosted model.
Does not publish to every social platform directly.
Users must verify rights, likeness use, and platform policy compliance.

use_cases.title: Plan Weekly Creator Assets
use_cases.description: Generate several short-form video concepts, captions, and image prompts from one content theme.

use_cases.title: Adapt Campaigns Across Platforms
use_cases.description: Convert one marketing idea into TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and X visual formats.

use_cases.title: Prototype Branded Visuals
use_cases.description: Create thumbnail, carousel, and product showcase prompts before final creative review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Short Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one platform-ready video idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15 second TikTok concept about [topic]. Include visual direction, mood, aspect ratio, and a clear opening hook.

prompt_templates.title: Write Captions and Hashtags
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a finished asset into post copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write three Instagram captions for [asset description]. Include a hook, a short call to action, and ten relevant hashtags.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose One Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Adapt one campaign idea for multiple channels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Repurpose [campaign idea] into formats for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X. Include asset type and copy angle for each.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch Content Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for a weekly content schedule.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-day content plan for [brand or creator]. Include video prompts, image prompts, caption themes, and publishing goals.

output_examples.input: A fitness coach wants three Reels about morning mobility.
output_examples.output: Three vertical video concepts with hooks, movement direction, caption angles, and hashtag themes.

output_examples.input: A SaaS launch needs one idea adapted for TikTok, X, and YouTube Shorts.
output_examples.output: A platform map with aspect ratios, visual style, copy direction, and thumbnail guidance.

output_examples.input: A creator needs a product unboxing post and carousel.
output_examples.output: A product showcase prompt, carousel frame ideas, caption options, and audience engagement prompts.

best_practices: Confirm the target platform, aspect ratio, and duration before generating assets.
Review prompts for brand safety, rights, and likeness consent before sending them to hosted models.
Keep a consistent visual style across batch outputs for the same campaign.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private campaign data or unreleased product details into hosted model prompts.
Do not publish generated people, voices, or products without rights review.
Do not use one generic prompt for every platform format.

faq.question: Does this skill create finished social media files?
faq.answer: It provides inference.sh workflows that can generate media outputs through supported hosted apps.

faq.question: Which platforms does it target?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram feed, YouTube Shorts, YouTube thumbnails, and X.

faq.question: Does it require an external account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows require the inference.sh CLI and a logged-in account.

faq.question: Can it write captions and hashtags?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompt patterns for captions, hooks, calls to action, and hashtag sets.

faq.question: Can it automate posting?
faq.answer: It includes a Twitter posting example, but users should review credentials and permissions before automation.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private content?
faq.answer: Use caution. Prompts and media URLs may be sent to hosted inference services.
